// GENERATED BY mkhandcurl.py -- DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
// How far each finger joint folds from open to a fist, in degrees.
//
// Source: FRIK's authored open and closed finger poses,
//   C:/Users/Command/Downloads/Fallout-4-VR-Body-0.79.1/src/skeleton/HandPoseData.cpp
// Method: the rotation taking openRotation to closedRotation, as an angle.
// Checked: 30 bones, left/right agree, joints 2-3 are hinges, angles 5-140.
//
// THE AXIS IS IN THE BONE'S OWN FRAME, not in world or model space:
//   +X along the bone toward the fingertip, +Z the flex axis, Y = Z x X.
// measure_avatar.py builds that same frame on each model from its rest pose,
// so this axis carries across rigs while nothing here is a model fact.
//
// For a finger's middle and tip joints the axis is a clean (0,0,1) hinge.
// The knuckles tilt slightly -- that is the splay direction built into the
// authored pose. The THUMB is tilted throughout, because a thumb does not
// hinge; that is why the axis is carried rather than assumed.
//
// A pose's flex value blends this: 1.0 = open (no fold), 0.0 = the full
// angle below. FRIK's own scale, so its pose tables can be used unchanged.
//
// finger  joint  degrees      axis x      y      z
